truth_audit_source: NO standalone TRUTH_AUDIT file — verdicts reconstructed from the R23conf closure wave (SSOT/paper-4/status.md + SSOT/queue.md header, 2026-06-09) + P4_R23CONF_COMPUTE_QUEUE.md. Raw reviewer findings: 150 across 7 reviewer files (R23conf_P4_SYNTHESIS.md).
audit_note: Closure wave: (a) headline real-space null REGENERATED from fixed generator — committed null generator had an all-CW selection bug (p_cw_eq>0.6 selector); 0.43σ/p=0.30 → 0.41σ/p=0.31, verdict unchanged; (b) per-galaxy label-shuffle null added (0.58σ); (c) HC selection explicit (N=949,584); (d) full-sample 4.2σ disclosed as low-confidence-tail systematics diagnostic. Clean-round counter stays 0/2 post-retraction.

findings.reviewer: truth-audit-recompute (triggered by reviewer reproducibility demands on the headline null)
findings.summary: The committed headline-null generator selected an effectively all-CW subsample via p_cw_eq>0.6 — a configuration the paper's text did not describe; paper narrative did not match the committed script.
findings.disposition: CLOSED — generator fixed, headline real-space null regenerated: 0.43σ (p=0.30) → 0.41σ (p=0.31), within MC noise, verdict unchanged; in-text correction note added. Pattern-043 (invented-configuration narratives) recurrence evidence.

findings.summary: Reproducibility anchor for the post-TTA dipole was assertion-only — it asserted the check passed without containing the observed/null raw values needed to verify it.
findings.disposition: Anchor flagged; 'we checked X' claims must point to artifacts containing computed values. Pattern-042 (hardcoded-literal artifact scripts) recurrence evidence.

findings.summary: Reviewer recompute claimed the headline dipole null could not be reproduced — but the variant table omitted the paper's documented combination; running the documented HC sample × documented estimator × pixel-perm null reproduces the headline.
findings.disposition: FALSIFIED — dissolved when the right SAMPLE × ESTIMATOR × NULL combination was run. Drove the new truth-audit rule: variant tables must include the paper's documented combination before any SEV verdict.

findings.id: P4-NULL-ROBUST (label-shuffle null + HC selection + full-sample disclosure)
findings.summary: Null-definition and selection-transparency gaps: per-galaxy label-shuffle robustness check absent; HC selection count implicit; full-sample 4.2σ undisclosed.
findings.disposition: CLOSED — label-shuffle null 0.58σ added; HC N=949,584 explicit; full-sample 4.2σ disclosed as low-confidence-tail systematics diagnostic.

findings.id: P4-SHAMIR-CITES (Shamir 2020/2012 arXiv IDs wrong; 2022a missing arXiv)
findings.summary: Ref [1] arXiv:2007.16116 should be 2007.12176; Ref [4] arXiv:1207.5464 should be 1207.7065; Ref [2] missing arXiv ID — rare genuine Perplexity citation catches.
findings.disposition: CLOSED in the v1.0.168 bundle (bib fixes).

findings.summary: Convergent demand to strip the retraction/provenance narrative ('that result is withdrawn', v1.0.76 references, artifact paths) from the body.
findings.disposition: Noted — deliberate post-retraction transparency policy; removal is Houston's call.

findings.summary: 8,474,531 'largest to date' claim lacks a literature-frontier comparison table (vs Shamir 2022, GZ DESI).
findings.disposition: Comparison-anchor framing decision; tracked with the compute queue (P4_R23CONF_COMPUTE_QUEUE.md).
